name: dfc
description: Dinasari Food Courier — hyper-local multi-service delivery for Madurai

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix firebase/functions run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix apps/mobile run lint
scripts.test: npm test -w @dfc/core && npm run test:indexes -w @dfc/firebase && npm run test:rules -w @dfc/firebase && npm run test:storage -w @dfc/firebase && npm run test:functions -w @dfc/firebase
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run web:build && npm run deploy:hosting -w @dfc/firebase
scripts.serve:hosting: npm run web:build && npm run serve:hosting -w @dfc/firebase
